title: Robbery
grade_or_penalty: 2nd degree; 1st degree if the actor attempts to kill, inflicts or attempts serious bodily injury, or is armed or threatens use of a deadly weapon
key_points: Inflicting bodily injury, using force, threatening immediate bodily injury, or threatening to commit a 1st or 2nd degree crime in the course of committing a theft.
Course of theft includes the attempt and immediate flight.
